type:
∀ {m : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] {α A δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    0 ≤ A →
      ∀ {q r : Fin m → ℕ},
        0 < r 0 →
          (∀ (j : Fin m), r j ≤ r 0) →
            2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|) ≤ δ ^ 2 * Real.log ↑(q 0) →
              0 < ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ (q 0) (r 0)) ∧
                ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ (q 0) (r 0)) ≤ ↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0)) ∧
                  ∏ j : Fin m, (↑(r j) + 1) < ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ (q 0) (r 0)) ^ δ
